tactics.label: Expert role framing
tactics.description: Assign the model an expert role to prime domain-appropriate depth and vocabulary.

tactics.label: Explicit constraint block
tactics.description: Enumerate requirements (time frame, depth, sources) as an unambiguous list.

tactics.label: Structured output request
tactics.description: Ask for a sectioned, well-organized deliverable rather than free-form prose.

tactics.label: Source preference
tactics.description: State preferred source types (primary, academic, official) to steer grounding.

tactics.label: Citation demand
tactics.description: Require inline citations so claims are traceable.

tactics.label: Approvable research plan
tactics.description: Ask the engine to outline a plan before executing, matching plan-surfacing deep-research modes.

tactics.label: Breadth directive
tactics.description: Instruct the engine to survey multiple perspectives and source types.

tactics.label: XML-delimited sections
tactics.description: Wrap task, constraints, and instructions in delimited tags for reliable parsing.

tactics.label: Reasoning-depth directive
tactics.description: Instruct explicit step-by-step reasoning across the requested number of layers.

tactics.label: Uncertainty flagging
tactics.description: Require the engine to flag uncertainty explicitly rather than guessing.

tactics.label: Concise keyword query
tactics.description: Compress the request into a short, search-engine-style query.

tactics.label: Source-filter operators
tactics.description: Add engine-supported operators (site:, filetype:, after:, before:) to constrain retrieval.

tactics.label: Recency constraint
tactics.description: Bound results to a recency window so stale sources are excluded.

tactics.label: Disambiguation preface
tactics.description: Fold clarifying answers into the prompt to remove ambiguity of scope or definitions.

tactics.label: Length / verbosity target
tactics.description: Signal desired output length to match the engine's verbosity sweet spot.

tactics.label: Negative constraints
tactics.description: State exclusions — what to avoid or leave out.

tactics.label: Task decomposition
tactics.description: Break a compound request into ordered sub-questions.

tactics.label: Audience persona calibration
tactics.description: Tune tone and depth to a stated target audience.

tactics.label: Premise demotion
tactics.description: Move an asserted-but-unverified premise out of the retrieval lead into an explicit claim-to-verify line, so nearest-neighbour search is not keyed on the assertion.

tactics.label: Entity site scoping
tactics.description: Map named organisations to their first-party domains and emit site: operators, so claims about an org are checked against that org's own publications.
